question: Where is fast food restaurant situated within 170 kilometers along the travel path toward Homewood Suites, Needham, MA from Cyrus Dallin Art Museum, Arlington, MA?
sql: WITH start_location AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Cyrus Dallin Art Museum%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Arlington%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%MA%' LIMIT 1 ), end_location AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Homewood Suites%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Needham%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%MA%' LIMIT 1 ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois AS p, start_location AS sl, end_location AS el WHERE p.amenity = 'fast_food' AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, sl.geometry::geography, 170 * 1000) -- within 170 km straight-line distance from the start point AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, ST_MakeLine(sl.geometry, el.geometry)::geography, 1000) -- within 1 km of the straight-line path between start and end ORDER BY ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, sl.geometry::geography);
